frozen_thresholds.rule: All gates required; gains on new road cannot compensate for foreground failure; report tails and changes separately

contract.lineage_timing: Lineage clarification recorded after v2 pilot and full49; not represented as a new preregistration or unchanged v1 asset hash
contract.interpretation: Asset identity differs transparently; original thresholds reused. The later lineage note is not a preregistration.

baseline_parity.depth_note: R0 normalizes depth on Torch/GPU; old V44 normalized saved depth_sum/alpha in NumPy/CPU. RGB/alpha/group are exact; depth has <=7.63e-6m arithmetic rounding and is not bitwise equal.
baseline_parity.limitation: Only8 full-precision baseline outputs were saved in this run; remaining90 cannot be independently float-reloaded. All98 have runtime assert<2e-6 records and exact saved PNG parity; no GPU replay performed.

mechanism_domain.rule: solo alpha>=0.98, excluding a6 box_candidate dilated2px and other_vehicle_guard; same per-frame mask across baseline/extension and keep/delete
mechanism_domain.derived_from: measured asset geometry rendered alone, not accuracy/hidden-GT or independently verified unoccluded pixels
mechanism_domain.confidence: World asset centers have >=3 stable real RGB sources and LiDAR-pool support. Per-pixel measured depth/source agreement is not saved in this domain.
mechanism_domain.warning: Larger ROI road alpha*T only demonstrates a mechanism. It cannot offset failed observed-road/foreground/protection accuracy gates.

observed_road_reference: Real same-frame observed road RGB. Delete images have no independent hidden clean-road GT under the removed actor.
tail_semantics: Frame regression quantiles and worst per-frame pixel-p95 deltas, not a reconstructed pooled pixel-p95.
source_code_note: Current root sources gained optional material/depth instrumentation after this run; review uses immutable saved metric fields, without backfilling new fields into the old receipt.

visual_review.selection: Worst observed-road and protected per-frame regressions, used only for review after evaluation.
observations: raw109/delete: extension introduces a visible dark band across the road behind the foreground vehicle compared with baseline.
raw130/delete: the added road has a clear transverse footprint/colour boundary and darker road patches; the foreground cars remain visually stable.
raw137/keep: a37 body remains visually stable while the visible road outside it acquires the extension colour change.
visual_review.interpretation: Visual inspection supports the numeric preservation failure; it does not supply hidden-road truth or validate completion accuracy.
